title: Tempo Provider Score
description: Declarative definition of a Tempo source: identifier, display, color, severity mapping, and default actions.

providerIdentifier.description: Stable, namespaced identifier for the source (reverse-DNS or scripts.<lang>.<name>).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the source panel.

color.description: Accent color for this source, as #RRGGBB.

severityDefault.description: Fallback severity when no rule matches.

severityRules.description: Ordered list of rules. First match wins.

match.description: Key/value pairs to match against event metadata. Values support glob-style wildcards (*).

label.description: Short badge label shown in the UI.

defaultActions.description: Actions offered for every event from this source. Per-event actions from the payload are appended.

grouping.description: Stack-grouping key template(s). Events sharing the resolved key collapse into one stack. Supports ${metadata.xxx} interpolation. Provide a single string for one template, or an array of strings for a fallback chain (runtime picks the first template that fully resolves).

groupingWindow.description: Time window inside which related events stack. Empty string = no cutoff (events stack regardless of how far apart in time).

openURL.description: URL to open. Supports ${metadata.xxx} interpolation. Schemes allowed in reviewed catalog: http, https, ssh, mailto, tel, and documented app schemes.

openTerminalWith.description: Shell command to open in Terminal. NOT allowed in reviewed catalog — local drop-in only.
